principle: Every sheet-affecting rule is either covered by a behavioral test, explicitly manual by design, or recorded as a known gap. CI fails on regressions in covered behavior and on unclassified new interactions.

domains.notes: Ability score to modifier calculation and final-score assembly.
Level-based proficiency bonus.
Class and selected feat save proficiency.
Species/class textual Advantage effects; Gnomish Cunning regression test included.
Class/background/feat skill proficiencies and expertise paths.
Common + two Standard Languages and choice handling.
Tool choice parsing, equipment resolution, and the complete PHB artisan-tool and instrument catalog.
Background +2/+1 and +1/+1/+1 plus feat ability choices.

Base class HP and every persistent PHB maximum-HP modifier (Tough, Dwarven Toughness, Boon of Fortitude, and Draconic Resilience) have exact scaling and combined golden cases; damage, healing, temporary HP, rests, and death state are covered separately.

Every PHB armor and Shield formula, Barbarian/Monk/Dance/Draconic unarmored formulas, training penalties, Defense, Medium Armor Master, magic enhancements, attunement, and stacking have golden cases. The 2024 Dual Wielder feat is explicitly verified not to receive its removed legacy AC bonus; reaction/trigger AC remains linked/manual.

Base Speed, class/feat bonuses, armor and Exhaustion penalties, condition-imposed Speed 0, and every persistent equal-to-Speed Climb/Swim source (Roving, Wild Heart, Athlete, Gift of the Depths, Aquatic Affinity, and Second-Story Work) are covered; activated movement modes remain linked/manual.

Base Dexterity, Alert, Dread Ambusher's Wisdom modifier, Feral Instinct, Remarkable Athlete, Assassinate, Exhaustion, armor penalties, and condition states are covered; target-, die-, and resource-triggered modifiers remain linked/manual.

Species senses, object- and prose-form Blindsight/Darkvision/Tremorsense/Truesight, range deduplication, Umbral Sight extension, Wild Heart, Feral Senses, Skulker, Boon of Truesight, Blind Fighting, and Witch Sight are covered; activated temporary senses remain linked/manual.

Species and feat selections, permanent subclass resistances, Elemental Affinity, Circle of the Land, Fiendish Resilience, Aura incapacitation, and Petrified are covered. The parser rejects choices and resistance-ignoring offense; activated or source-conditional resistance remains linked/manual.
Simple/martial/category parsing plus exact-name proficiency.

All 40 PHB table weapons have corpus-backed ability, proficiency, damage-type, Versatile, Heavy, magic-bonus, condition-state, and mastery-aware profiles. Target choices remain interactive, while every sheet-resolvable attack and damage value has an exact behavioral assertion.
All nine PHB weapon properties and object-form conditional properties are normalized and corpus-tested.

All eight PHB mastery properties, class progression, Weapon Master feat choice counts, selection reconciliation, and notes are covered. Every PHB weapon now produces an exact trigger/outcome profile, including Cleave attack and damage, Graze damage, Topple save DC, and the fixed Nick, Push, Sap, Slow, and Vex outcomes; current values are rendered in weapon Notes.
All twelve PHB armor suits plus Shield are corpus-tested for AC, Dexterity caps, training, Strength, Stealth, and non-stacking behavior.
items.json + items-base.json merge, indexing, search, categories, starting-equipment refs, quantities, weight, carrying capacity, equip/wield state, and attunement state.
Armor penalties, weapon/armor enhancement bonuses, and attunement gating are derived; conditional activated magic-item effects still require explicit state models.

All twelve PHB classes and all 48 PHB subclasses have exact resource profiles. Golden cases cover every scaling dice breakpoint, die size, recovery cadence, split free-cast pool, alternate recovery route, reconciliation rule, and Arcane Ward's empty-on-create and Long-Rest-reset lifecycle; Battle Master's rendered pool is verified in Chromium.
Core slot progression calculations are tested.
Pinned class/subclass lists, spell-level eligibility, Wizard spellbook preparation, feat spell picks, and the live Chromium selection path are behaviorally tested.
Class/subclass counts, eligible lists, bonus cantrips, feat cantrip choices, UI selection, and save/reload persistence are tested.
2024 prepared-spell limits, always-prepared spells, Wizard spellbook rules, Eldritch Knight/Arcane Trickster progressions, legacy known-spell migration, and Chromium persistence are tested.
Short/Long Rest resource recovery, HP, temporary HP, spell slots, Hit Dice, Exhaustion, Concentration, and Long Rest eligibility are behaviorally tested.
Availability, spending limits, Constitution healing, zero-floor healing, maximum-HP clamping, and Long Rest restoration are tested.
Healthy, Dying, Stable, and Dead states; success/failure limits; damage at 0 HP; critical hits; massive damage; temporary HP; and healing resets are tested.
Damage, healing, temporary HP absorption, zero-HP transitions, death-state recovery, and rest interactions have direct behavioral coverage.

All fifteen PHB conditions are explicitly classified. Speed, attacks, checks, saves, initiative, Concentration, inherited conditions, damage resistance, immunity, Exhaustion, UI selection, and persistence have behavioral coverage.

All 77 PHB feats are classified. Ability/ASI, saving-throw, skill, tool, mixed proficiency, Expertise, damage/resistance, and spell choices are reconciled, corpus-tested, and exercised through Chromium persistence.
Singular/plural lineage/ancestry choice detection regression tests.

All 48 PHB subclasses and 309 subclass-feature records are level-gated. Battle Master maneuvers, Champion Fighting Style, proficiency choices, Circle of the Land, Wild Heart, Fiendish Resilience, Iron Mind, Magical Discoveries, and all four Savant progressions have behavioral coverage; transient target/per-use subclass decisions remain linked rules rather than permanent sheet state.

All 58 PHB optional features are classified. Metamagic, Eldritch Invocation, and Battle Master progression, categories, levels, dependencies, repeatability, deduplication, persistence, invocation cantrip targets, fixed invocation spells, Pact of the Tome's three cantrips plus two rituals, and Lessons of the First Ones Origin feats have hard behavioral coverage.
Notes are linked through the same rules-reference renderer.

Chromium verifies species, background, class-feature, language, skill, the full structured feat-choice surface, Battle Master maneuver, dependency-gated invocation, Circle of the Land spell-group, Pact of the Tome spell, invocation-target, Lessons of the First Ones Origin-feat, ordinary spell, condition, and equipment choices through save/reload; remaining transient subclass controls still need scenarios.
A touch-enabled Chromium scenario verifies long-press references and suppression of the following click; ordinary condition state changes are covered by the condition-controls scenario.
IndexedDB save/reload and persisted schema migration are verified in Chromium in addition to pure migration contracts.
Chromium performs a complete pinned-corpus synchronization, activates the service worker, disconnects the network, and reloads the character and rules library offline.
